note: P2 wave 2 — humanities and arts specifically. Nine rows across ACLS, the Getty Research Institute and NEH. new_rows.stated_purpose: Supports emerging researchers to complete work on projects related to the Getty Scholars Program's annual theme, in residence at the Getty.
new_rows.eligibility_window: Predoctoral: advanced to candidacy by the deadline. Postdoctoral: doctorate received within the past 5 years.
new_rows.eligibility_notes: Residency at the Getty Center or Getty Villa in Los Angeles is required. Dedicated grants exist for fellows expanding critical inquiry of African American art under the Getty's African American Art History Initiative.
new_rows.specific_topic: art history and visual studies, on the Scholars Program's annual theme
new_rows.status_evidence: “Applicants for 2027-2028 (Paused)” on Getty's own programme page, linked to the “temporary closure of the Getty Center from March 15, 2027 through spring 2028”. The project itself is still labelled Status: Active (1985 – present) and a 2026–27 cohort is in residence, so this is a suspended application cycle with a stated horizon rather than a wind-down.
new_rows.notes: Added 2026-09-18 (P2). PAUSED for the 2027-2028 academic year while the Getty Center closes for modernisation (15 March 2027 to spring 2028). The funder's page carries both a project-level Status: Active and an explicit “Applicants for 2027-2028 (Paused)” heading; the row follows the applicant-facing label because that is what an applicant acts on. PROVENANCE: stipend amounts and the eligibility windows were read through the search index, hence confidence=medium and a blank award_checked.

new_rows.specific_topic: art history and visual studies, on the Scholars Program's annual theme
new_rows.status_evidence: “Applicants for 2027-2028 (Paused)” on Getty's own programme page, linked to the “temporary closure of the Getty Center from March 15, 2027 through spring 2028”.
